sar.narrative: Between 2016-11-11 and 2016-11-11, suspicious transaction activity totaling $100.09 was identified on card C04570-K1 owned by customer C04570. Activity matched the 'card_not_present_new_device' typology. The primary transaction was conducted via the online channel. The cardholder verified unauthorized activity. The compromise connects to 2593 other card(s) through shared device profiles. Immediate mitigation including card blocking and downstream monitoring was enacted in accordance with bank policy.
